description: Find which app marketplaces list a company. Give a company domain (for example klaviyo.com), optionally its name, or a list of domains. Checks HubSpot App Marketplace, Salesforce AppExchange, Slack Marketplace, Zapier, Shopify App Store, Atlassian Marketplace, Chrome Web Store, Microsoft Marketplace, Google Workspace Marketplace, and the WordPress plugin directory, and returns one row per company with, for each marketplace, the listing URL, listing name, installs, rating, review count, last update, a status (listed, not_found, blocked, skipped), and a match confidence (1.0 linked from the company site, 0.9 listing names the company domain, 0.7 name match only). Companies with no listing come back free with row_status not_listed. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per listing found.

company_domain.description: A company website domain, for example klaviyo.com. Give this, company_name, or domains.

company_name.description: Optional. The company or product name as marketplaces show it, for example Klaviyo. Read from the homepage when omitted. With no domain, matching is by name only, at 0.7 confidence.

domains.description: Several company domains. Each gets its own row. Up to 500 per run.

marketplaces.description: Which marketplaces to check. Omit for all ten.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before any row that would take its charges over this amount.

proxy_mode.description: auto connects directly and moves a host that refuses to the Apify proxy default pool; direct never uses a proxy; residential uses Apify residential proxy. Proxy use adds nothing to the price. Default auto.

skipCache.description: true checks every company again instead of the free 7 day cache in your account. Default false.

name: get_marketplace_presence
title: Get marketplace presence
